name: architecture-tabs-section
purpose: The architecture band of a product page: a horizontal section title with one large button, over a row of up to five tabs whose active tab draws its named diagram the full width of the frame. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'architecture-tabs-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `module`, `module-header`, `button`, `registration-frame`, `media-tabs` and `diagram`. The tabs advance on a timer that pauses under the pointer or keyboard focus and never runs under reduced motion; that state is owned by `media-tabs`.
useWhen: Use ArchitectureTabsSection only when every tab shows a full-width official diagram (up to five tabs).
To plot several architectures of one product, or one request across the platform, one diagram at a time.
avoidWhen: For features shown by an illustration each → use `feature-tabs-section`.
related: `media-tabs` — the timed tab row this section renders through.
`diagram` — the named architecture diagram each tab draws.
bestPractices: Keep to five tabs with `tabsSide` `top` or `bottom`, three with `start` or `end`; tabs past the limit are not rendered.
Give every tab a `diagram` from the diagram library and a stable `value`.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the horizontal section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: tabsSide
props.doc: Side of the diagram the tabs sit on: `top`, `bottom`, `start` or `end`; start and end hold up to three tabs.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: The architectures, in order; each is `{ value, title, description, diagram, diagramAriaLabel? }` where `diagram` is the name of the diagram drawn while the tab is active and `diagramAriaLabel` replaces the description that diagram ships.

props.name: autoplay
props.doc: Opens the next tab on a timer, with the composed tabs' visible pause control.

props.name: autoplayInterval
props.doc: Milliseconds each tab holds before the next one opens.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Large button in the section title; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.
